title: Muscat calm wind -> Brent +3d
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Muscat max wind 10d z-score below -1 (calm Gulf of Oman) leads Brent higher by 3 days (+); trade long BZ=F 4d [weather.muscat.wind_max -> finance.BZ=F.log_return]
message: Not supported: calm Muscat wind does not lead Brent higher (r=-0.04, n=388, validity 0); backtest rule flips sign to high-wind long (Sharpe-like 1.97, n=29) - likely noise.

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.muscat.wind_max rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long BZ=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 6 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Muscat max wind 20d z-score above 1 (rough Gulf of Oman seas) leads Brent intraday range higher by 2 days (+); trade long BZ=F volatility 3d [weather.muscat.wind_max -> finance.BZ=F.range_pct] (parent: R2-0011)
